title: T1585.002 — Establish Accounts - Email Accounts
subtitle: Watch an attacker prepare a lookalike mail domain and run a phishing wave, with the defender view at each step.
aria: Animation of an attacker registering a lookalike domain, creating mailboxes, warming them up, sending a phishing wave to a company, and the SOC responding.
